articles.title: 'Kidnapped, tied to tree, set on fire': Social media influencer dies in Punjab
articles.summary: Manjeet Kaur died after suffering severe burn injuries from an alleged abduction and attack. She was reportedly taken to a forested area and set on fire near Morinda.

articles.title: A Pocso case. A man in coma. A murdered model: Delhi gym trainer's trail of violence
articles.summary: In a chilling revelation, Mohammad Imran, charged in the murder of Muskan, carries a record of alarming criminal behavior. He faced a POCSO allegation in 2018 involving the harassment of a young minor and was later implicated in an assault case that rendered the victim comatose in 2021.

articles.title: ‘How can this happen?’: Sky opens up on shock India snub after T20 WC triumph
articles.summary: Suryakumar Yadav expressed surprise after losing his T20 captaincy role. He had led India to T20 World Cup and Asia Cup victories.

articles.title: Nepal floods: Morgues overflow along 200km river trail as grief crosses border
articles.summary: Morgues in Nepal are overflowing with bodies from a recent flash flood. Authorities are converting buildings into temporary mortuaries as district facilities are full.

articles.title: In 2002, Alabama architecture students stacked 72,000 worn carpet tiles into the walls of a family home
articles.summary: Students at Rural Studio have transformed donated carpet tiles into the innovative Lucy Carpet House, providing a vital home and prayer space for the Harris family. This initiative is part of a broader effort that has resulted in over 200 projects within Hale County, enabling students to gain hands-on experience while tackling the challenges of affordable housing in rural communities..

articles.title: A former Illinois school is now a $1.35M accessible park with an inclusive playground and splash pad
articles.summary: On August 26, Galesburg proudly unveiled Cooke Park, a fully accessible neighborhood space built on the site of the former Cooke Elementary School. This ambitious $1.352 million project features an inclusive playground and splash pad, showcasing the community's dedication to inclusivity.

articles.summary: The National Testing Agency will soon release the CSIR-UGC NET June 2026 results. Candidates can check their scores on the official csirnet.nta.nic.in website.

articles.title: PSEB Class 10 supplementary result 2026 declared at pseb.ac.in: Direct link to download scorecards here
articles.summary: The Punjab School Education Board (PSEB) has announced the Class 10 supplementary result 2026 for students who appeared in the July examination. Candidates can now access their scorecards online through the official PSEB website using their examination details.

articles.title: Bihar Board marksheets to replace ‘fail’ with ‘eligible for skills’ to protect students’ morale
articles.summary: Bihar plans to replace the word “fail” on Class 10 and 12 marksheets with “Kaushal ke liye patra” to avoid negatively labelling students. The Education Department will also introduce month-long special classes for Matric supplementary candidates.

articles.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: Check circle-wise vacancies for 23,757 posts here
articles.summary: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: India Post has announced 23,757 Gramin Dak Sevak vacancies under the July 2026 engagement schedule. Maharashtra has the highest listed circle-wise vacancy count with 2,297 posts, followed by Tamil Nadu with 2,118 and Uttar Pradesh with 1,691.

articles.title: Soori thanks filmmaker Vetri Maaran at 'Mandaadi' Chennai audio launch event
articles.summary: In a recent event, actor Soori shared insights into the challenges faced during the intense sea shoot for the film 'Mandaadi.' He expressed gratitude towards director Vetri Maaran for his unwavering support, which has significantly impacted his career. The team endured perilous conditions while capturing scenes over two months.

articles.title: Shelley Fabares passes away at 82
articles.summary: Actress Shelley Fabares, known for 'The Donna Reed Show' and 'Coach', has passed away. Her family confirmed her death was due to pneumonia following a brief illness.

articles.title: When Manisha Koirala revealed if actresses can really be friends
articles.summary: During a recent chat show, Manisha Koirala opened up about the complexities of friendships among actresses. She highlighted that while insecurity can hinder genuine connections, male actors appear to bond with greater ease.

articles.title: Samay mocks Sharon Verma's Bihari roots on 'Latent 2'
articles.summary: In a hilarious back-and-forth, comedian Sharon Verma fired back at Samay Raina after he teased her about her Bihari roots. With brilliant timing, she playfully brought up Raina's Kashmiri background and his fondness for getting 'stoned', turning the tables with laughter erupting from both the panel and audience.
